candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] {V : Type u_2} {W : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V]
  [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k V] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} W] [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_3} k W]
  [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} k V],
  Exists.{max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)} fun e =>
    ∀ (f : Module.Dual.{u_1, u_2} k V) (w : W) (v : V),
      Eq.{u_3 + 1}
        (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1}
          (DFunLike.coe.{max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1), max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1),
              max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)}
            e (TensorProduct.tmul.{u_1, max u_1 u_2, u_3} k f w))
          v)
        (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_3, u_3} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_1 + 1} f v) w)
